description: This file contains JavaScript functions for managing widgets and dashboard components in the vtiger CRM system, including adding, deleting, loading, and arranging widgets on the homepage.

methods.name: chooseType
methods.description: Handles the display and AJAX loading of different widget types based on user selection.

methods.name: setFilter
methods.description: Sets the filter list when a module name is changed, via AJAX.

methods.name: setPrimaryFld
methods.description: Sets the primary field list based on selected module, via AJAX.

methods.name: showEditrow
methods.description: Displays the div for selecting the number of rows in a widget.

methods.name: cancelEntries
methods.description: Hides the div for selecting the number of rows in a widget.

methods.name: saveEntries
methods.description: Saves the maximum entries to display in a widget via AJAX.

methods.name: saveEditDash
methods.description: Saves dashboard configuration via AJAX.

methods.name: DelStuff
methods.description: Deletes a widget from the homepage via AJAX.

methods.name: loadAddedDiv
methods.description: Loads a newly added widget into the homepage.

methods.name: loadStuff
methods.description: Reloads widget content based on widget ID and type.

methods.name: loadAllWidgets
methods.description: Loads multiple widgets in batches, updating their content via AJAX.

methods.name: frmValidate
methods.description: Validates the form for creating a new widget and submits via AJAX.

methods.name: HideDefault
methods.description: Hides a default widget via AJAX.

methods.name: fnRemoveWindow
methods.description: Hides the widget dropdown window.

methods.name: fnShowWindow
methods.description: Shows the widget dropdown window.

methods.name: positionDivInAccord
methods.description: Positions a widget div based on layout and type.

methods.name: hideSeqSettings
methods.description: Hides the sequence settings div.

methods.name: fetch_homeDB
methods.description: Fetches the homepage dashboard content via AJAX.

methods.name: initHomePage
methods.description: Initializes sortable homepage layout.

methods.name: BlockSorting
methods.description: Saves the new order of widgets after sorting.

methods.name: isIE
methods.description: Detects if the browser is Internet Explorer.

methods.name: addNotebookWidget
methods.description: Adds a notebook widget to the homepage.

methods.name: addScrollBar
methods.description: Adds scrolling to a widget.

methods.name: showOptions
methods.description: Displays a UI node centered on screen.

methods.name: hideOptions
methods.description: Hides a UI node.

methods.name: saveLayout
methods.description: Saves the selected homepage layout via AJAX.

methods.name: saveEditReportCharts
methods.description: Saves report chart widget configuration via AJAX.
